themes.consensus_view: Both banks see demand for AI computing capacity continuing to grow, with no bank in the evidence arguing against it.

facts_agreed.claim: Both banks say demand for compute and inference capacity is rising and is not being met.
evidence_quotes: millions of persistent agents doing work continuously, that is another powerful accelerator for inference
If compute keeps getting more valuable because there isn’t enough, it is very hard to be bearish

themes.consensus_view: Both banks covering this theme are positive, saying demand for AI memory chips is running ahead of supply and is helping hold up the broader tech and AI trade.

facts_agreed.claim: Goldman Sachs and JPMorgan both see AI-driven memory demand as a fundamental support for tech.
evidence_quotes: AI and HBM demand continues to outstrip supply
we still see the tech/AI complex being supported fundamentally
